## 2. Executive Biography

Niraj Kumar Pandit (also known as Niraj Kumar Prajapati and Niraj Prajapati) is a Full Stack Software Developer from Birgunj, Narayani, Nepal. He graduated with a Bachelor of Computer Applications (B.C.A., CGPA 8.55/10) from DIT University, Dehradun, India (2023–2026) and works at Dynamic Technosoft Pvt. Ltd. (https://www.dynamic.net.np). As a Full Stack Developer, he has engineered multiple Government of Nepal & civic platforms (PGEMP-Platform, Government Public Web CMS), institutional commerce portals (BICCI / ICCI), and is actively building Pivotal ERP, an IRD-approved enterprise cloud ERP system for 12+ industries.

## 3. Selected Projects & Architecture

### 1) PGEMP-Platform — Political Governance, Constituency & Election Management Platform
- **Category**: Nepal Civic Governance, Constituency & Election Intelligence Platform
- **Backend Architecture**: ASP.NET Core Clean Architecture & CQRS (`PGEMP.slnx`)
  - `PGEMP.API`: REST Controllers (`CitizenController`, `DashboardController`, `ElectionController`, `GisController`, `OppositionController`), `Program.cs`, `appsettings.json`, `Dockerfile`
  - `PGEMP.Application`: CQRS Commands (`CreateElectionCommand`, `LogHouseholdCommand`, `RegisterCandidateCommand`) and Queries (`GetCitizenByIdQuery`, `GetElectionSummaryQuery`, `ValidateBoundaryQuery`)
  - `PGEMP.Domain`: Rich domain entities (`AdminUser`, `Citizen`, `CitizenInteraction`, `FamilyRelationship`, `Household`, `Ward`, `Election`, `CandidacyRegistration`, `OppositionCandidate`, `OppositionSupportMapping`, `Role`, `RolePermission`, `Volunteer`, `VolunteerTask`, `VolunteerFieldReport`, `VolunteerTeam`, `VolunteerTeamMember`) and Enums
  - `PGEMP.Infrastructure`: Entity Framework `PGEMPDbContext`
- **Database & DevOps**: 13 versioned SQL migrations (`001_admin_hierarchy.sql` through `013_admin_users.sql` covering governance, campaign, finance, volunteer field ops, and RBAC), master seed scripts, `init.sh`, Docker Compose (`deploy/docker-compose.yml`), Nginx reverse proxy (`nginx.conf`), and multilingual Nepali/English user guides.
- **Frontend Architecture**: React + TypeScript + Vite (`Shell.tsx`, `globalStore.ts`, `useModulePermission.ts`, `useTranslation.ts`) covering Citizen Directory & Bulk Upload, Voter Canvassing Hub & Classification Engine, Booth & Election Command Dashboard, Political CRM & Manifesto Comparator, Volunteer Portal, Campaign & Event Planners, Governance Dashboard & Project Monitoring, Asset Register & Bank Reconciliation, Media Center (News Threat Radar, Sentiment Analysis, Broadcast & Social Studio), AI Predictive Insights & AI War Room Copilot Drawer, and Granular RBAC Management.

### 2) BICCI / ICCI — Birgunj Chamber of Commerce & Industries (CMS & Public Website)
- **Category**: Nepal Government / Institutional Portal & Custom CMS
- **Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, ASP.NET Core Web API / CMS Routes, SQL
- **Capabilities**: Built both the public institutional website and the administrative Content Management System (CMS) for managing news coverage, hero banners, executive members, projects & programs, acts & regulations, gallery, events, media room, membership registrations/renewals, and Certificate of Origin (NNSW) portal access.

### 3) Pivotal ERP — Integrated Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (Currently Working On)
- **Category**: IRD-Approved Enterprise Cloud ERP (12+ Industries across Nepal & South Asia)
- **Target Industries**: Retail (POS, multi-counter, barcode), Wholesalers (bulk orders, godowns, credit ledger), Importers & Exporters (LC, duty, freight), Automobile (job cards, spare parts), Petroleum (pump meter, dip stock, shifts), Manufacturing (multi-stage BOM, WIP, batches), Healthcare (OPD/IPD, lab receipts), Academics (student fee billing, payroll).
- **Modules**: Accounting & Finance (double-entry ledgers, trial balance, Bikram Sambat fiscal analytics, depreciation), Inventory Management (multi-godown stock aging, FIFO), Sales & Distribution (quotations, sales orders, delivery notes), Purchase Management (vendor requisitions, RFQs), HR & Payroll (biometrics, employee records), Loan & Cooperative (member share capital, recurring deposits), Fixed Assets Register, Project Management (BOQ & timelines), RBAC, Excel import/export, and real-time IRD CBMS electronic billing synchronization.
